variants.headline: Our election operation succeeds
body: Our secret effort to sway a city-state's election has succeeded. The vote went the way we worked for.

variants.headline: Our election operation fails
body: Our secret effort to sway a city-state's election has failed. The vote did not go our way.

variants.headline: A quiet success in {{cityState}}
body: We are informed that patient work by our people in {{cityState}} has borne fruit. The election there has ended in our favor, and the government's judgment in backing the work stands confirmed.

variants.headline: Who answers for the failed election?
body: Citizens, the attempt to sway a city-state's election has come to nothing. Someone chose that ground, and the public has yet to hear the case for it. A failed operation owes an accounting, and this paper means to keep asking until it gets one.

variants.headline: The election, measured in influence
body: The record puts the change in our influence with the city-state at {{influence}} points. It is the one firm measure of what the operation achieved, and the next such effort will be weighed against it.

variants.headline: Our diplomat takes up post in {{civilization}}
body: We have posted a diplomat to {{civilization}}. The envoy will speak for us at that court and keep our government informed of what it intends.

variants.headline: A diplomat posted abroad
body: We have posted a diplomat to a foreign capital. The envoy opens a direct line between our government and another major power.

variants.headline: An envoy established at {{capital}}
body: In the manner of former reigns, an envoy of ours is now established at {{capital}}, the seat of {{civilization}}. Letters will pass between the two courts, as letters between courts always have.

variants.headline: A diplomat goes to {{civilization}}
body: Our diplomat is in {{civilization}} tonight. The envoy speaks for us there, and listens. In the contest of courts, an ear at another table counts for a regiment in the field.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is caught and identified
body: A foreign spy working against us has been caught. The intruder has been identified, and the government now knows whose service was behind the attempt.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is killed
body: A foreign spy working against us has been caught, and did not survive it. The government knows whose service sent the intruder.

variants.headline: Hear it! A spy is taken in {{cityName}}
body: People of {{cityName}}, a foreign spy has been caught at work in the city. Caught, and stopped! Go about your business; the watch is awake.

variants.headline: A spy among us, caught!
body: Foreign eyes were at work in our streets, neighbors. They are caught now. The councils keep their secrets, but this much is owed to the street: the watch was equal to it.

variants.headline: Our spy is detected abroad
body: One of our spies working abroad has been detected. The watchers there know someone was at work against them, but not whose it was.

variants.headline: Our work in {{target}} loses its quiet
body: The operation in {{target}} has been noticed. Our part in it stays hidden, and that is the whole of the good news. A watcher who is noticed is a watcher wasted, and someone chose that ground. The next such choice deserves a harder look.

variants.headline: Detected, and perhaps not empty-handed
body: We are informed that our agent abroad was noticed at the work. Even so, letters home suggest the attempt may have obtained {{possibleTechnology}} for us, which would soften the misstep considerably.

variants.headline: Our spy is noticed in {{cityName}}
body: In the ordinary course of the quiet service, one of ours has been noticed in {{cityName}}. The other side knows an agent was at work there; whose agent, the record does not say.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is detected at home
body: Our watchers have detected a foreign spy at work inside our borders. The intruder was noticed but not identified, and the hand behind the work remains unknown.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is killed, unnamed
body: Our watchers have killed a foreign spy caught working inside our borders. The intruder has not been identified, and the hand behind the work remains unknown.

variants.headline: Notice: the watch is awake
body: We are informed that our watchers have marked a foreign agent at work inside our borders. The agent's employer remains unknown, and the government's counter-work goes on.

variants.headline: Someone was watching {{cityName}}
body: A foreign spy has been spotted at work in {{cityName}}. Who sent them, the record does not say. The market filled its stalls as usual, but people counted their change a little more carefully.

variants.headline: Our spy is identified abroad
body: One of our spies has been identified at work abroad. The other side knows whose agent it was, and the work there can no longer be done quietly.

variants.headline: Our spy is killed abroad
body: One of our spies has been killed at work abroad. The other side knows whose agent it was, and the operation is ended with them.

variants.headline: Our spy is killed abroad, unnamed
body: One of our spies has been killed at work abroad. The other side stopped the agent without learning whose service sent them, and our hand in the matter stays hidden.

variants.headline: Named in {{target}}, and no one explains
body: One of ours stands named as a spy in {{target}}. An operation that ends with our name in another capital's mouth has failed at least half its work. Who weighed that risk, and for what? The public is owed the answer.

variants.headline: The cost of the quiet work in {{target}}
body: An agent of ours is dead in {{target}}, and {{target}} knows whose. The quiet work abroad has a price, and the nation has just paid it: one agent, and the secrecy that agent kept. What the work was worth, the record does not say.

variants.headline: An agent of ours, unnamed
body: The state does not print the name, but the loss can be noted. One of our agents has died abroad in the secret work. What the agent gathered and what the mission cost stay with the office that sent them. The rest of us hold the debt.

variants.headline: Our spy may have gained {{possibleTechnology}}
body: One of our spies has finished working abroad without being noticed. The record suggests the operation may have obtained {{possibleTechnology}} for us.

variants.headline: The quiet account
body: The work abroad, in short:
Detection: none. Likely gain: {{possibleTechnology}}.
The years of study we did not spend are the years we keep.

variants.headline: Unnoticed in {{target}}
body: Our people worked {{target}} tonight without being detected, and the record says we may have obtained {{possibleTechnology}} from the attempt. If the gain holds, the distance in learning between the two nations narrows, and no workshop in either country hears of it.

variants.headline: Quiet win: possibly {{possibleTechnology}}
body: Nobody noticed us. The record says we may have picked up {{possibleTechnology}} in the process. That is the whole story, and it is a good one.

variants.headline: Our spy takes up post in {{cityName}}
body: One of our spies has been stationed in {{cityName}}, a city of {{civilization}}. The posting begins the work of watching that city from inside its walls.

variants.headline: A quiet posting to {{cityName}}
body: We are given to understand that one of our people is now placed in {{cityName}}, of {{civilization}}. The nation's standing is kept by many kinds of work, and not all of them are loud.

variants.headline: One of ours goes to {{cityName}}
body: It is told that one of our quieter folk has gone to live in {{cityName}}, in the land of {{civilization}}. They will walk the markets, mind the talk, and send home what the wind carries.

variants.headline: Eyes inside {{cityName}}
body: A spy inside {{cityName}} is more than a listener. The posting is an early line on what {{civilization}} builds, moves and plans, and news that arrives from inside a city arrives earliest. The quiet placements are where the next war shows first.

variants.headline: A diplomat of {{civilization}} arrives at our capital
body: A diplomat of {{civilization}} has taken up residence at our capital. The envoy opens a direct channel between the two governments, and the conversations begin.

variants.headline: A foreign diplomat arrives
body: A foreign diplomat has taken up residence at our capital. The envoy opens a direct channel between our government and another major power.

variants.headline: An envoy from {{civilization}} at our court
body: We are informed that an envoy of {{civilization}} is now received at our capital. Two governments that speak directly have less cause to speak sharply, and the paper welcomes the channel.

variants.headline: A listener at our table
body: A diplomat of {{civilization}} now sits at our capital. A good guest listens more than speaks, and we should assume the conversations travel home in full. Hospitality is right; carelessness is not. The paper's counsel is a warm welcome and an open eye.
